name: foleo
description: Publish and manage Markdown and eligible active HTML artifacts on Foleo through its remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Reversible share links for Markdown and approved HTML.
interface.longDescription: Foleo turns a document into a reversible share link. Connect once through your browser and your agent can publish Markdown, update it in place, inspect what the account already holds, and unpublish, delete, or restore it; deleted artifacts empty from a 30-day trash automatically. Changing what other people can see always needs your approval. Eligible accounts can also publish approved active HTML.
